subject: CloudWave marketplace listing — technical & legal blockers
messages:
From: Maya Singh <maya@cloudwave.ai>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace integration kickoff and dependencies

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — CloudWave's platform team is excited about the Redwood runtime performance and the prospect of listing our connector in your marketplace. Before we schedule the formal kickoff, a couple of sticky items came up internally that I wanted to surface so your team can prepare: 

- Marketplace SKU mapping: we need to map our SKU tiers (Starter/Scale/Enterprise) to Redwood entitlements and confirm overage behavior.
- Data residency requirement: one of our enterprise customers requires that inference logs for their workspace stay in us-west-2 only. Is there a per-account region binding you support for logs/metrics?
- Legal: our contracts team asked about indemnity language around model hallucinations — do you have a standard marketplace EULA or need us to propose redlines?

I'll attach our marketplace onboarding checklist; can you point me to the right people on your side for product/tech/legal so we can align milestones? Would love to get a mutual action plan (MAP) and an earliest GA estimate.

Best,
Maya
Product Partnerships | CloudWave

Attachment: cloudwave_mcp_requirements.pdf

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@cloudwave.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace integration kickoff and dependencies

Maya — thanks for the clear list. High level: we can support SKU entitlement mapping and per-account metrics routing, but both have downstream tech and legal implications so we'll need a short exception path for launch on two items. Quick answers and proposed owners: 

- SKU mapping: Vanessa (cc'd) owns Marketplace Ops and will coordinate billing/entitlement mapping. She'll need your billing SKU table and expected seat/req thresholds.
- Logs residency: Ben (cc'd) from infra should weigh in — we have region-scoped telemetry ingestion but cross-account isolation will require an opt-in configuration and a small architectural change to the metrics pipeline.
- Legal/EULA: I'll loop in Legal via formal invite; for now, share the specific indemnity language that you're seeing so we can triage.

Proposed next step: 30-minute MAP call on Tuesday 5/25 to agree milestones and any listing exception requests. I'll draft a short MAP and circulate. If you can share the checklist and preferred dates, we'll lock it.

Thanks,
Aditya
Senior Partner Manager | Redwood Inference

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@cloudwave.ai>, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-20T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace integration kickoff and dependencies — Ops details + exception asks

Hi Maya — welcome. I reviewed your checklist (attached) and sketched the operational asks we need to resolve before listing: 

1) Billing/entitlement mapping: we can support three SKU tiers. To avoid double-billing windows we ask partners to provide a deterministic SKU->product_code table and the expected average monthly active seats. Please send a CSV of SKU, product_code, price_band, and billing cadence.

2) Entitlement enforcement: Redwood requires a token exchange flow for entitlement validation (OAuth2 + partner JWT). Priyom (cc) can run the integration spec; we typically allow an exception to shim a signed API key for initial pilot but it must expire after 30 days.

3) Launch exceptions: two possible exceptions for GA: (a) Lease of region-scoped logs to partner-managed buckets (ops change), (b) Alternate indemnity clause requested by CloudWave Legal. Both require a documented MOP and signoff from Legal & Security.

I attached a proposed MOP with checklist fields and tentative owners — see 'proposed_mop.xlsx'. If CloudWave can accept a 90-day pilot with the token-shim and sign the MOP and the limited indemnity rider, we can proceed with a controlled GA.

Thanks — Vanessa
Partner Ops Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_mop.xlsx

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, Maya Singh <maya@cloudwave.ai>
Date: 2027-05-20T14:41:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace integration kickoff — infra blockers and timeline implications

Maya / Team — quick engineering read:

- Region-bound telemetry: We have a sharded ingestion path (us-west-2, eu-west-1) but per-account binding is not currently surfaced. Implementing per-account log routing is ~3 sprints of work (design + small infra change + migration plan) if we schedule it as a backend change.

- Token shim: We can support a time-limited API-key shim for a pilot. Security note: request must include key rotation schedule and an IP allowlist.

- Performance validation: to join the Redwood catalog we run a 72-hour perf soak using your connector under representative traffic. If you have benchmark harnesses we can run them in our staging — please provide request/response size distribution.

Suggested plan (minimal):
1) Pilot (30 days): token-shim + limited pilot accounts + perf soak.
2) MOP signoff: Ops + Security + Legal agree on residual risks and mitigation.
3) GA (after region-binding work or explicit exception).

If MAP meeting is 5/25 I can have a short tech brief and perf checklist ready.

—Ben
Infra Lead, Serving Runtime | Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: Maya Singh <maya@cloudwave.ai>, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudWave Legal <legal@cloudwave.ai>, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-21T17:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CloudWave marketplace listing — MAP + action items (5/25 call)

Thanks everyone — summary and agreed next steps ahead of our MAP call (Tue 5/25 10:00am PT):

- Deliverables from CloudWave before the call: SKU->product_code CSV, sample perf harness (or traffic profile), specific indemnity clause language. (Owner: Maya)
- Deliverables from Redwood before the call: draft MOP and short pilot proposal (Vanessa), token-shim spec + perf checklist (Ben), draft exception rider template for Legal (Aditya).
- Temporary exceptions agreed in principle: 30-day pilot with token-shim and IP restrictions; region-scoped logs will be a tracked engineering ticket (PARTNER-1284) with an estimated 3-sprint timeline for per-account binding.
- Risk items to be elevated to Legal/Security during MAP: indemnity redlines, log residency SLA, and telemetry access.

I'll send a calendar invite and a one-page MAP doc (Drive link below) that we'll use to capture commitments. Please confirm if CloudWave can sign the MOP and accept the pilot constraints — if yes, we can slot the perf soak immediately after pilot onboarding.

Links: https://drive.company/shared/CloudWave-Marketplace-Pack, HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company/deal/HW-7423, DocuSign: https://company-docusign.com/signer/abc123

Thanks,
Aditya
